summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing its inclusion in the Russell 1000 Index and Russell 3000 Index effective June 29, 2026, following the annual Russell indexes reconstitution based on market capitalization rankings. The filing does not involve any transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or special situation; it is a routine index inclusion announcement. No terms, advisor, or board action are specified. As a non-US filer, Form 6-K reports material information; this is a regulatory filing of a passive index event with no actionable event-driven angle.
